deck.caption:
Your fixed deposit might look safe on paper, but the return you see on the branch board is rarely the return that hits your bank account.

Here is what you need to know about bank FD returns in October 2026:
• Pre-tax rates across SBI, PNB, HDFC, and ICICI differ from what you actually keep
• FD interest gets added to your total income and taxed at your slab rate
• Why calculating net post-tax return on a ₹5 lakh deposit matters before locking in tenure

Save this guide for your next bank visit and share it with someone planning an FD.

When choosing a fixed deposit, do you factor in your income tax slab or do you simply pick the highest advertised rate?
